description: REST API and MCP server for daily TCGplayer market prices and price history (since 2024-02-08) of Pokemon, One Piece, Lorcana, Riftbound, Gundam, Yu-Gi-Oh and Dragon Ball Super Fusion World cards and sealed products, with Python, JavaScript, Google Sheets, Discord and Next.js examples.
rules: Base URL is https://api.tickermint.cards; send the key from the TICKERMINT_API_KEY env var as the X-API-Key header. The key is optional: without one the API answers 25 card lookups a day per IP with 30 days of history, for personal use, to try it.
Call the API from server code only (backend, route handler, server component, script, bot); it blocks browser CORS calls and keys must never reach the client.
Always send a User-Agent header; Python urllib's default User-Agent is blocked with 403.
Prices are raw (ungraded) USD decimal strings like "300.29" or null; parse with a decimal type. product_id is the TCGplayer product id.
Prices update once a day: cache every answer for at least 1 hour and no longer than 24 hours (Next.js: fetch(url, { next: { revalidate: 3600 } })).

Show a visible "Prices: TickerMint" link to the product's tickermint_url (or https://tickermint.cards/card/{product_id}) next to displayed prices; required on every plan except API Platform and Enterprise.
Never copy or mirror the catalog or price history for redistribution or a competing price service.

A key comes with a plan. Every plan starts with a 7-day trial (card required, cancel online anytime) at https://tickermint.cards/developers#plan. Trials are capped at 5,000 lookups and have no bulk history until the first payment.

Plan choice: personal or non-commercial project = Developer $19/mo (50,000 lookups a month); any commercial product (store, paid or ad-supported app, business tool) = API Pro $49/mo (250,000 a month) or API Business $249/mo (1,500,000 a month); no attribution link or a product for other businesses = API Platform $599/mo (5,000,000 a month).

Graded prices (PSA, BGS, CGC, SGC, TAG and ACE 10s, plus grades 1 to 9.5) are a paid add-on on API Pro and above and carry their own source credit, which must stay visible. The MCP server at https://api.tickermint.cards/mcp does not cap ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity; any other caller gets 300 tool calls a day.
Moving from pokemontcg.io (its API keys stop working on March 1, 2027): GET /cards/{pokemontcg.io id}, for example /cards/sv3pt5-199, returns the same card with today's market price.

On 401/402/403/429 read the JSON body: detail and how_to_fix (show one), error (code), upgrade_url (show it), required_plan, docs_url, pricing_url. On 429 wait Retry-After seconds; do not retry 401/402/403.

Search with GET /products/search?q=<name and collector number>&game=<pokemon|one-piece|lorcana|riftbound|gundam|yugioh|fusion-world>; history with GET /products/{id}/prices, keyed by printing, oldest first.
Live plans and limits: https://tickermint.cards/pricing.json. Full agent docs: https://tickermint.cards/llms-full.txt. OpenAPI: https://api.tickermint.cards/openapi.json.
